text:
nina: FYI release v2.4 cut is blocked. Promote failed during artifact verify — one shard is zero bytes. Deploy-bot aborted the cut.

nina: Promote log snippet:
```
verify: fetch shard part-4.tar.gz -> read 0 bytes
verify: expected 18,234,112 bytes, got 0
promote: verify failed -> abort
```

deploy-bot: :x: Automatic abort at 1719992222: artifact verification failed (zero-length shard). Rollback enforced to last promoted tag v2.3. See ticket infra#4301.

rachel: I saw a failing integration test in the canary earlier (test_user_session_timeout) but didn't connect it to artifacts. That test was red on 2/3 runs.

tom: Looking at storage logs, there was a concurrent prune job that kicked at 02:14UTC while the multipart upload was finishing. Prune removed the incomplete part, leaving a zero-byte placeholder. Likely race between artifact-publisher and registry-gc.

ops-bot: Noted. Current options: 1) re-upload shard from build cache, re-run verify and promote (fast), 2) pin release to v2.3 for the change window and open hotfix/hydrate job for v2.4, 3) attempt forced-promote (not recommended).

nina: We need to respect the change window for the next 2 hours. v2.4 contains a behavioural flag flip that must have docs & release notes published prior to user exposure. So forced-promote is off the table. Recommend pin to v2.3 for the window.

rachel: +1 to pin. Also want to triage flaky integration test separately; not a blocker for the pin. I'll open qa#564 to capture the failure pattern and attach canary logs.

tom: I'll kick a re-hydrate job to rebuild the artifact from the build cache and re-run the multipart upload with stricter ETag validation. Command: `./bin/hydrate-artifact --build=ci-2041 --shard=4 --zone=us-west-2 --verify-etag`

ci-bot: Hydrate job queued -> started. Running checksums and smoke integration harness in a staging namespace.

ci-bot: Hydrate complete; verification OK. However note: integration smoke run showed the same intermittent `test_user_session_timeout` flake (1/3).

ops-bot: Given ci-bot result and docs dependency, proceeding with plan: 1) Pin cluster traffic to v2.3 for the current change window (operations will keep the previous tag pinned), 2) Open hotfix branch v2.4-regen for artifact regen and CI triage, 3) Schedule a rerun promote into the next change window once docs and test stability are confirmed.

nina: Who will update release notes & notify marketing when we move the promote?

rachel: I can handle release notes push to the repo and ping marketing. I'll also update the changelog for the flag details. ETA 30m.

tom: Filed follow-up infra task infra#4302 to add an uploader-side guard: while multipart upload in progress, disable registry prune for that key (2m grace). Also adding upload etag verification earlier in pipeline.

nina: OK. For immediate steps: ops to pin v2.3 now, tom to finish the hydrate upload, rachel to prepare notes. If hydrate passes and docs ready, we'll attempt promote in the next change window (T+3h). If tests keep flaking, we'll delay.

ops-bot: Pin executed: routing set to v2.3, autoscaler preserved. Notifying on-call and infra.

nina: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene in #eng-releases after the hydrate completes. :hourglass:
